description: A ground surface through contour lines, as SketchUp's Sandbox From Contours: each contour a line of plan points (mm) at its height (mm above the ground), closed for rings. The surface is a grid (spacing mm, default 1000) over their extent and 2 m round it; between contours it's interpolated. It paints, cuts and exports like any object, and the user can sculpt it. Returns its id, size and lowest and highest points.

items.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

name: make_terrain
title: Make terrain from contours
